title: More detailed phone internals and a refined learning workbench
summary: Replaced plain internal blocks with detailed component assemblies and refined the Phone Lab layout for smaller screens.

changes.detail: Layered battery pouch with seams and markings; PCB traces, contacts, processor shield, inset memory chips, camera housings, sensor optics, speaker grille, USB recess and chassis screws.
Compact mobile canvas, graphite studio background, quieter selection treatment, rectangular controls, organized full-width topic rows and refined lesson typography.
Large all-caps battery/speaker block labels and excessive selection outlines across component polygons.

validation.name: Visual and regression validation
validation.detail: Pending model rendering, interaction regression, typecheck, lint and history checks. No deployment.
